'''''Biometrics''''' is a [[Academic journal|journal]] that publishes articles on the [[Application software|application]] of statistics and mathematics to the biological sciences.<ref name="JSTOR">[https://www.jstor.org/journal/biometrics JSTOR entry on biometrics]</ref> It is published by the [[International Biometric Society|International Biometric Society (IBS)]].<ref name="IBS">[http://www.biometrics.tibs.org/ Biometrics homepage] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070625090905/http://www.biometrics.tibs.org/ |date=June 25, 2007 }}</ref>

== History ==
Originally published in 1945<ref>[https://www.jstor.org/journals/00994987.html Biometrics Bulletin JSTOR Coverage]</ref> under the title ''Biometrics Bulletin'', the journal adopted the shorter title in 1947.<ref name="BiometricsV3I1">[https://www.jstor.org/stable/3001538 Biometrics, Vol. 3, No. 1, Mar., 1947 Page 53]</ref> A notable contributor to the journal was [[Ronald Fisher|R.A. Fisher]], for whom a memorial edition was published in 1964.<ref name="BiometricsV20I2">[https://www.jstor.org/stable/i343394 Biometrics, Vol. 20, No. 2, In Memoriam: Ronald Aylmer Fisher, 1890-1962, Jun., 1964]</ref> In a survey of statistics researchers' opinions, it was [[ranked]] fifth overall among 40 statistics journals, and it was second only to the ''[[Journal of the American Statistical Association]]'' in the ranking provided by [[biometrics]] specialists.<ref>{{citation|first1=Vasilis|last1=Theoharakis|first2=Mary|last2=Skordia|journal=The American Statistician|volume=57|issue=2|year=2003|title=How do statisticians perceive statistics journals?|doi=10.1198/0003130031414|pages=115|s2cid=122626806}}.</ref>
